mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.tenant_id, r.message_id, r.user_id, m.connection_id, m.title, m.content, r.delivery_status, r.delivery_attempts FROM sys_message_receiver r INNER JOIN sys_message m ON m.id = r.message_id AND m.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.send_channel = 'COLLABORATION'

SELECT r.id, r.tenant_id, r.message_id, r.user_id, m.connection_id, m.title, m.content, r.delivery_status, r.delivery_attempts FROM sys_message_receiver r INNER JOIN sys_message m ON m.id = r.message_id AND m.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE m.send_channel = 'COLLABORATION' AND r.delivery_status = 'FAILED' AND r.next_retry_time IS NOT NULL AND r.next_retry_time <= #{now} ORDER BY r.next_retry_time ASC LIMIT #{limitSize}
